verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the self-hosting docs, which list "prompt engineering" as a core LangSmith capability and link to a prompt hub page. That shows some prompt-management feature exists, but nothing in the pack describes prompt versioning, environment tags, or pulling prompts at runtime so changes reach production without a code deploy. Missing for 10: documented prompt versioning/commit history, a mechanism to promote prompt versions to production without redeploying code, SDK runtime prompt-pull evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
